name: Limitless Nexus: Scarlet Peach Providers
description: Adult-only Scarlet Peach stream providers for Nuvio. Hanime remains the stable schema-v2 provider. HentaiHaven now uses a dual-backend resolver: the working hentaihaven.com secure-token/HLS path first, then hentaihaven.xxx search/watch/AJAX fallback for titles missing from the .com catalog.

scrapers.name: Hanime
scrapers.description: Hanime provider for Scarlet Peach MAL/AniList/SP metadata and compatible legacy HentaiStream title slugs. Exact schema v2 Hanime episode mappings bypass catalog search and go directly to the signed AES-GCM handshake. Optional account settings authenticate directly from Nuvio to Hanime and pass only the temporary session token to the resolver for premium qualities. Stream labels follow the Nexus quality/audio standard and include verified censorship metadata when available.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus: Scarlet Peach; protocol references from Yuzono AniYomi Hanime and anime-src/hanime-stremio

scrapers.name: HentaiHaven
scrapers.description: Experimental dual-backend HentaiHaven provider. Tries hentaihaven.com using the current x-secure-token player/HLS flow, including Octopus VP9 playlists, then falls back to hentaihaven.xxx using its WordPress search/watch/AJAX player path. Backend-specific playback headers and HLS/MP4 are preserved. Visible diagnostics remain enabled while matching coverage is being verified.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus: Scarlet Peach; protocol references from cynthia2006/hanime-plugin and ngomile/anigrab HentaiHaven extractors
